title: MeasuredPrice

measurement_unit_for_pricing.description: The measurement unit used to measure the item. This should be used only for items whose price depends on quantity sold. These are also referred as weighted items

estimated_units_per_item_for_pricing.description: Estimated units per unit of item. This value will be used to calculate estimated price for total number of units. The unit of measurement used will be measurement_unit_for_pricing. This should be used only for items whose price depends on quantity. These are also referred as weighted items

description: The values for items whose price depends on the quantity sold. Also referred as weighted items.
